items.title: Google’s best practices for recycled materials
items.summary: Google’s Pixel 10a smartphone, launched in March, contains 36 percent recycled materials, by weight, more than the latest Apple iPhone models.

items.title: How gamification can nudge employees to act more sustainably
items.summary: AstraZeneca and Amgen are among the winners of a competition that demonstrates how gamification can motivate companies and employees to tackle sustainability challenges.

items.title: In Practice: Five ways businesses are charging ahead with electrification to combat energy costs
items.summary: With businesses struggling to communicate sustainability endeavours transparently and dealing with short-term budget constraints, edie’s new ‘in practice’ series explores how some organisations are trialling and installing innovative projects to deliver climate action.

items.title: Lidl GB scales Olio surplus food partnership to almost 200 stores
items.summary: Lidl GB and food redistribution platform Neighbourly are scaling up their partnership with food-sharing app Olio to around 200 stores.

items.title: ‘Deeply disappointing’: Gatwick to begin second runway development after court rejects legal challenge
items.summary: Gatwick Airport will begin development of its second runway after campaigners lost a legal challenge against the expansion plans.

items.title: ‘We will go full steam ahead on electrification’, says Volkswagen boss
items.summary: Volkswagen will continue its transition to electric vehicles (EVs) despite policy uncertainty and changing market conditions, according to the company's chief sustainability officer, Dirk Voeste, who said chief executive Oliver Blume has made clear the group will not change course.

items.title: Q&A: What is in China’s new five-year plan for climate change?
items.summary: China has released a five-year plan dedicated to addressing climate change.
